summary: Verified the Pyodide/Pymunk WASM worker boot fix. The /engine-check.html self-check page reached terminal status OPEN_READY in ~4s (well under the 150s budget) with the exact expected log progression: DOWNLOADING GAME ENGINE -> STARTING GAME ENGINE -> LOADING PHYSICS -> GAME ENGINE READY -> PREPARING WORLD -> PREPARING WORLD 40/250 -> 'WORLD READY — engine booted and population prepared'. No ENGINE_ERROR / WORKER_ERROR / TIMEOUT / FETCH_ERROR occurred. Main menu at / renders correctly with LASTZHOOD title, START GAME button, and EARLY nav button (visually confirmed in screenshot). Both runtime wheels serve as real binaries: pymunk-7.2.0-cp313-cp313-pyodide_2025_0_wasm32.whl -> 200, application/octet-stream, 228174 bytes; pathfinding-1.0.22-py3-none-any.whl -> 200, application/octet-stream, 26213 bytes. The 'PREPARING WORLD' hang bug is fixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Engine self-check lives at /engine-check.html and uses data-testid='engine-check-status' / 'engine-check-log'. Required wheels are in /app/frontend/public/local-runtime/. Expected terminal status: OPEN_READY within ~5-120s. Wallet/payment flow was intentionally NOT tested (out of scope and not automatable).
rca of the issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent): Pyodide package wheels (micropip, pydantic, pydantic_core, cffi, pycparser, typing_extensions, typing_inspection, annotated_types) plus pymunk-7.2.0 and pathfinding-1.0.22 wheels were missing from frontend/public/local-runtime/. Requests for these paths returned the SPA index.html fallback (HTML, not a wheel), so Pyodide's loadPackage/micropip.install threw and the worker never progressed past 'PREPARING WORLD'. Mitigation: wheels were committed to /local-runtime/ and verified to serve with content-type application/octet-stream. Verified now via engine-check.html reaching OPEN_READY and the two curl HEAD/GET checks returning proper binary sizes.
